---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability or a rule change
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem** — what cannot be done today, and who is blocked by it

**Who is affected** — servers, cashiers, kitchen, store manager, brand admin, integrator

**Proposed behaviour** — describe the rule, not the implementation

**Out of scope** — what this deliberately does not cover

**Documents this would change**
- [ ] `docs/pos-spec.md` §
- [ ] `docs/architecture.md`
- [ ] `docs/ui-ux.md`
- [ ] New ADR required (port, protocol, dependency, or security boundary)

**Why now** — if this is deferred work, state the activation threshold it has reached (see `docs/design-principles.md` §YAGNI)
